headword: {共用|きょうよう}{部分|ぶぶん}

definitions.gloss: shared area; common area; common-use space
definitions.explanation: Areas in an apartment building or condominium that are shared by all residents, such as hallways, lobbies, elevators, and parking lots. Contrasted with the individual units owned or rented by each resident.

examples.japanese: {共用|きょうよう}{部分|ぶぶん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{清潔|せいけつ}→清潔：01583_seiketsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{保|たも}つ→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧。
{共用|きょうよう}{部分|ぶぶん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}かないで→置く：01092_oku⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please do not leave belongings in the common areas.

examples.japanese: ⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{共用|きょうよう}{部分|ぶぶん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{修繕|しゅうぜん}→修繕：06569_shuuzen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{管理|かんり}{費|ひ}→管理費：06575_kanrihi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧まかなわれる。
examples.english: Repairs to the shared areas of the apartment building are covered by the management fee.

notes:
A real estate and housing management term combining ⟦{共用|きょうよう}→共用：21529_kyouyou⟧ (shared use) and ⟦{部分|ぶぶん}→部分：03715_bubun⟧ (area/part). Important for anyone living in a Japanese apartment building, as rules governing shared spaces are strictly enforced.

COMMON SHARED AREAS:
- ⟦エントランス→エントランス：08938_entoransu⟧ / ⟦ロビー→ロビー：26995_robii⟧: entrance / lobby
- ⟦{廊下|ろうか}→廊下：05005_rouka⟧: hallways
- ⟦エレベーター→エレベーター：01340_erebeetaa⟧: elevators
- ⟦{階段|かいだん}→階段：00782_kaidan⟧: stairs
- ⟦ゴミ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧⟦{置|お}き{場|ば}→置き場：22477_okiba⟧: trash collection area
- ⟦{駐輪場|ちゅうりんじょう}→駐輪場：09240_chuurinjou⟧: bicycle parking area
- ⟦{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}→駐車場：01667_chuushajou⟧: parking lot

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {共用|きょうよう}{部分|ぶぶん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{使用|しよう}→使用：01637_shiyou⟧⟦ルール→ルール：00354_ruuru⟧: rules for using shared areas
